paper.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks

result.summary: 本文提出检索增强生成（RAG）模型，将预训练参数记忆（BART）与非参数记忆（Wikipedia 稠密向量索引，经 DPR 检索）结合，并端到端微调 [S1.p2]。作者比较了 RAG-Sequence 与 RAG-Token 两种形式，在多个知识密集型任务上评估 [S2.p2][S3.p1]。RAG 在三个开放域问答任务上取得当时最优结果，并优于参数化 seq2seq 模型和任务特定的检索-抽取架构 [abstract]。在生成任务上，RAG 生成的文本比纯参数化 BART 基线更具体、多样且事实准确 [abstract]。作者还展示了通过替换非参数记忆索引即可更新模型知识 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：大型预训练语言模型虽能存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力有限，在知识密集型任务上落后于任务特定架构，且难以提供决策溯源和更新世界知识 [abstract]。作者探索一种通用微调方法，将预训练参数记忆与非参数记忆结合用于语言生成 [abstract]。其动机是混合模型可直接修订和扩展知识，且访问的知识可被检查和解释 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.
We explore a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) — models which combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation.

Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.

method.text: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。模型包含两个组件：检索器 p_η(z|x) 返回 top-K 文本段落分布，生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1}) 基于前文、输入和检索段落生成当前 token [S2.p1]。检索器基于 DPR 双编码器，生成器使用 BART-large，两者联合端到端训练，将检索文档视为隐变量 [S2.p2][S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS3.p1]。作者提出 RAG-Sequence（整个序列使用同一文档）和 RAG-Token（每个 token 可使用不同文档）两种边缘化方式 [S2.p2]。

evidence.quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.

our models leverage two components: (i) a retriever $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ with parameters $\eta$ that returns (top-K truncated) distributions over text passages given a query $x$ and (ii) a generator $p_{\theta}(y_{i}|x,z,y_{1:i-1})$
To train the retriever and generator end-to-end, we treat the retrieved document as a latent variable.
In one approach, RAG-Sequence, the model uses the same document to predict each target token. The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based on a different document.
The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR.
We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters.

experiments.text: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月 Wikipedia dump，每篇文章切分为 100 词块，共 2100 万文档，用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时 k 由开发集设定 [S3.p1]。评估任务包括四个开放域问答数据集（NQ、TQA、WQ、CT）、MSMARCO 抽象问答、Jeopardy 问题生成和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS4.p1]。

evidence.quote: Following and, we use the December 2018 dump. Each Wikipedia article is split into disjoint 100-word chunks, to make a total of 21M documents.
We use the document encoder to compute an embedding for each document, and build a single MIPS index using FAISS with a Hierarchical Navigable Small World approximation for fast retrieval.
We consider $k\in\{5,10\}$ for training and set $k$ for test time using dev data.
We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.
FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.

findings.text: RAG 在四个开放域问答任务上均取得当时最优结果，且无需昂贵的专门预训练 [S4.SS1.p1]。RAG 能生成正确答案，即使正确答案不在任何检索文档中，在 NQ 上此类情况准确率达 11.8%，而抽取式模型为 0% [S4.SS1.p2]。在 MS-MARCO 抽象问答上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 BLEU 和 2.6 Rouge-L [S4.SS2.p1]。在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence 和 BART，人工评估显示 RAG 更事实、更具体 [S4.SS3.p1]。在 FEVER 上，RAG 3-way 分类结果与最优模型差距在 4.3% 以内，且无需检索监督 [S4.SS4.p1]。通过替换非参数记忆索引，RAG 可更新世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
Unlike REALM and T5+SSM, RAG enjoys strong results without expensive, specialized “salient span masking” pre-training.
Furthermore, RAG can generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not in any retrieved document, achieving 11.8% accuracy in such cases for NQ, where an extractive model would score 0%.
RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
Evaluators indicated that BART was more factual than RAG in only 7.1% of cases, while RAG was more factual in 42.7% of cases
For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.

limitations.text: 作者指出，在初步实验中，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”并学习检索相同文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 性能与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。FEVER 的另一个子任务（抽取证据句子）因 FEVER 使用不同的 Wikipedia dump，直接处理并不简单，作者希望未来解决 [A5.p1]。此外，作者尝试添加“空文档”机制但未发现性能提升，因此省略 [A6.p1]。

evidence.quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
In these cases, once retrieval had collapsed, the generator would learn to ignore the documents, and the RAG model would perform equivalently to BART.
As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
We did not find that these improved performance, so in the interests of simplicity, we omit them.
